dogecoin.text: @itsALLrisky @mcuban @BitPay @vladtenev Meant to be spent? By whom? People who have millions? I’m not spending my doge when it’s worth $0.36 and I’m DOWN! I’m hoping it goes to $1. The biggest inhibitor to its growth is it’s instability. Nothing is priced in Dogecoin.

@mcuban @BitPay Why would anyone spend or accept doge or any token that volatile? They don’t. No one is going to sell a car for 80,000 Dogecoin. They’ll accept the equivalent to $30k USD. Stop pretending it’s anything more than speculation. A spendable token has to be stable.
